title: A Club Where Lions Dance and Traditions Take Root ｜ 一所狮子起舞、传统扎根的俱乐部

sents.en: The first thing you notice in the staircase to the fourth-floor studio on Canal Street in Manhattan, New York, is the measured thumping coming from behind a metal door.
sents.cn: 在纽约曼哈顿运河街那间四楼练功房的楼梯上，你首先注意到的是一扇金属门后传来的有节奏的咚咚声。

sents.en: Just beyond the entrance, large lion masks were twisting and turning to the drum-beat.
sents.cn: 刚过入口，几只巨大的狮头正随着鼓点翻转舞动。

sents.en: On a recent Friday evening, the teenagers made their way across the studio floor as they practiced Chinese lion dancing.
sents.cn: 最近的一个周五晚上，一群青少年穿过练功房的地板，练习中国舞狮。

sents.en: "You want to play in a circle," Victor Fong, aged 24, told his students at the New York Chinese Freemasons Athletic Club.
sents.cn: "你要走成一个圆圈，"24岁的维克多∙方在纽约华人致公堂体育俱乐部对学生们说，"慢一点，再来一遍。

sents.en: "Take it slow and do it again." The dance group, made up of 60 members, performs throughout the year but was now preparing for its biggest events, Chinese Lunar New Year celebrations, which will begin on Saturday and conclude on February 15.
sents.cn: "这支由60名成员组成的舞蹈队全年都有演出，眼下正在为最重大的活动做准备——从周六开始、2月15日结束的农历新年庆祝活动。

sents.en: Teenagers comprise about half of the group, many of whom began lion dancing at the age of 14.
sents.cn: 青少年约占队伍的一半，其中许多人14岁就开始学舞狮。

sents.en: About 100 current and past members of the dance group·which has been performing since 1956·will be among the 220 groups marching through Chinatown in Manhattan for the 18th Lunar New Year Parade on February 5.
sents.cn: 这支自1956年以来一直演出的舞蹈队，约有100名现任和往届成员，将加入2月5日穿行曼哈顿唐人街的第18届农历新年游行的220支队伍之中。

sents.en: Mr. Fong has been involved in the organization since he was 15 and began teaching lion dancing three years ago.
sents.cn: 方先生从15岁起就参与这个组织，三年前开始教舞狮。

sents.en: But the club also acts as a recreation center and safe haven for teenagers, with video games readily available.
sents.cn: 但这个俱乐部也是青少年的娱乐中心和庇护所，电子游戏随手可玩。

sents.en: As many as 20 students show up after school.
sents.cn: 放学后来这里的学生多达20人。

sents.en: "The basic requirement for hanging out here is you have to learn to lion dance," Mr. Fong said.
sents.cn: "在这里混的基本要求就是你得学舞狮，"方先生说。

sents.en: While that is not a formal requirement for being a member, everyone finds a way to participate in the Lunar New Year Parade, whether it's by dancing, carrying a flag or beating a drum.
sents.cn: 虽然这并非成为会员的正式要求，但每个人都会找到参加农历新年游行的办法，无论是跳舞、举旗还是打鼓。

sents.en: Alvin Chau, aged 26, is an environmental consultant by day and a lion dancer on weekends.
sents.cn: 26岁的阿尔文∙周白天是环境顾问，周末则是舞狮者。

sents.en: He has been a club member for 10 years and joined because of an interest in lion dance.
sents.cn: 他成为俱乐部会员已有10年，当初出于对舞狮的兴趣而加入。

sents.en: "We're a big family," he said, shaking hands with other members as they walked through the door.
sents.cn: "我们是个大家庭，"他说，一边与其他进门走来的成员握手，"这里每个人都认识。

sents.en: "You know everyone."
It is believed that the lion dance began in the third century.
sents.cn: 人们认为舞狮始于公元三世纪。

sents.en: Stories vary about how lion dancing came to be, but most of them include a monster named Nian who would terrorize a village.
sents.cn: 关于舞狮的由来说法不一，但大多数都提到一个叫"年"的怪物，它常常恐吓村庄。

sents.en: The villagers finally banded together and scared the beast away with firecrackers and drums.
sents.cn: 村民们最终团结起来，用爆竹和鼓声吓走了这头野兽。

sents.en: While lions are not native to China, some versions of the story include the villagers creating a monster of their own in the shape of a lion to fight off the beast.
sents.cn: 虽然狮子并非中国本土动物，但在故事的有些版本里，村民们自己造出一个狮子形状的怪物来驱赶那头野兽。

sents.en: Today, the dancers travel across Chinatown going from business to business to bring good luck for the coming year.
sents.cn: 如今，舞狮者们穿行唐人街，一家家店铺走过去，为来年送去好运。

sents.en: The new year·according to the Chinese lunar calendar· will begin on Saturday and marks the Year of the Rooster, which is thought to be a symbol of positivity.
sents.cn: 按照中国农历，新年将于周六开始，是鸡年——人们认为鸡是积极向上的象征。

sents.en: "It's almost like the dark night is ending and the sun is coming up," said Ya Yung Teng, the digital collections coordinator for the Museum of Chinese in America.
sents.cn: "这几乎就像黑夜将尽、太阳升起，"美国华人博物馆的数字藏品主管滕雅容说，"我们有希望迎来新的一天。

sents.en: "It's hopeful that we're going to have a new day." Roosters and chickens are not particularly strong creatures, Ms. Teng said, but they are numerous.
sents.cn: "滕女士说，公鸡和鸡并不是特别强壮的动物，但它们数量众多。

sents.en: "In a way," she said, the rooster "stands for 'We the People.'"
sents.cn: "在某种意义上，"她说，公鸡"代表着'我们人民'"。

sents.en: The lion head and tail are operated by two people.
sents.cn: 狮头和狮尾由两人操作。

sents.en: As one person controls the head, a second follows under a train of fabric representing the body.
sents.cn: 一人控制狮头，另一人在代表狮身的一长串布料下跟随。

sents.en: The dancers move in harmony as they imitate the animal's natural movements in the wild, including the aggressiveness of an attack.
sents.cn: 舞者们动作协调，模仿这种动物在野外的自然举动，包括进攻时的凶猛。

sents.en: A lion head figure weighs under 10 pounds and sits squarely on the dancer's shoulders.
sents.cn: 狮头不到10磅重，端端正正地架在舞者的肩上。

sents.en: Inside, the dancer manipulates strings that open and close the lion's eyes, shake its ears and open its mouth to reveal a fire-orange tongue.
sents.cn: 在狮头里面，舞者操纵着一些细绳，让狮眼开合、双耳抖动、嘴巴张开，露出橙红色的舌头。

sents.en: "A good lion dancer will imitate a living creature," said Karlin Chan, aged 59, who heads the athletic club's community public relations.
sents.cn: "优秀的舞狮者会模仿一种活的生物，"59岁的卡林∙陈说，他负责这家体育俱乐部的社区公关。

sents.en: "I started lion dancing when I was a kid," he said.
sents.cn: "我从小就开始舞狮，"他说，"那时唐人街比现在小得多，那是一场有烟花和爆竹的庆典，为它增添了许多趣味和意义。

sents.en: "Chinatown was much smaller then and it was a celebration with fireworks and firecrackers, which added a lot of flavor and meaning to it."
Mr. Chan buys a new lion head each year when he travels to China. A head costs about $1,500. "If you want the good stuff, the quality, you have to see it for yourself," he said.
sents.cn: 陈先生每年去中国都会买一个新狮头。

sents.en: "I'll inspect the product before we put it in the container and ship it over." Mr. Chan, who has been involved with the club for nearly 50 years, said that passing the dance from one generation to the next was vital.
sents.cn: 一个狮头约需1,500美元。"如果你想要好东西、要品质，就必须亲自去看，"他说，"在装集装箱运过来之前，我会亲自检验产品。

sents.en: "You need to pass on the traditions and the culture, and this is a part of our culture," he said.
sents.cn: "参与俱乐部近50年的陈先生说，把这门舞蹈代代相传至关重要。

sents.en: "It's a great way to promote cultural understanding and exchange; we welcome that."
sents.cn: "你需要把传统和文化传下去，而这是我们文化的一部分，"他说，"这是促进文化理解与交流的好方式；我们对此持欢迎态度。"

sents.en: For Sara Pore, aged 17, another club member, lion dance is more than just tradition, it provides a creative outlet.
sents.cn: 对另一位俱乐部会员、17岁的萨拉∙波雷来说，舞狮不仅仅是传统，它还提供了一个发挥创造力的出口。

sents.en: "Lion dancing started 2,000 years ago·that's incredible," she said.
sents.cn: "舞狮始于2,000年前——太不可思议了，"她说，"但让你成为一名称职舞狮者的，是其中蕴含的想象力。

sents.en: "But what makes you a competent lion dancer is that there's a sense of imagination involved.
sents.cn: 正因为如此，舞狮能教会你领导能力。

sents.en: Lion dancing teaches competence in leadership because of this.
sents.cn: 你不断被迫把自己推过极限。

sents.en: You're constantly forced to push yourself past your limit."
Back at rehearsal, Justin Le, aged 18, tied a red ribbon around his waist to practice jumping.
sents.cn: 回到排练场，18岁的贾斯廷∙黎在腰间系上一条红丝带练习跳跃。

sents.en: The dancers use the ribbons to pull themselves up over their partners' heads.
sents.cn: 舞者们借助丝带把自己拉起来、越过搭档的头顶。

sents.en: The room's ceilings are too low to wear the lion heads for jumping practice, so once up on his partner's head, Mr. Le held out his arms as if in offering.
sents.cn: 房间的天花板太低，练跳时无法戴着狮头，所以黎先生一上到搭档的头顶，就伸出双臂，仿佛在献上什么。

sents.en: Mr. Le comes by the dance as a legacy.
sents.cn: 黎先生的舞艺来自家传。

sents.en: "I was born into it," Mr. Le said, noting that his uncle and father were club members.
sents.cn: "我生在这个里面，"黎先生说，他的叔叔和父亲都是俱乐部成员。

sents.en: "Growing up, I would always watch my family and see the lion dance, and I slowly grew interested in it." By the age of 14, he was fully enrolled in the athletic club's lion dance group.
sents.cn: "从小到大，我总是看着家人舞狮，慢慢就产生了兴趣。

sents.en: "I value my culture and tradition, being Chinese or Asian-American.
sents.cn: "到14岁时，他已正式加入这家体育俱乐部的舞狮队。

sents.en: I have a lot of pride in that," he said.
sents.cn: "我珍视自己的文化和传统，作为华人或亚裔美国人，我为此深感自豪，"他说，"我想为社区做贡献、回馈社区。

sents.en: "I want to contribute and give back to the community."
